composition.story: Six numbers on a line must split into two groups. Two centroids start as guesses. Each round, every point joins its nearest centroid, then each centroid moves to the mean of its group. Watch the groups and the squared-distance cost settle until nothing changes.

aha.observation: Round three changes no point's group and no centroid moves, so the loop stops. Cost fell from 217 to 9.33 and stays there.

variants.label: k-means, k=2, points on a line (1, 2, 4, 9, 10, 12). Cost = sum of squared distances from each point to its centroid. Rounded to 2 decimals.

states.label: Data
states.sentence: Six unlabeled points sit on a line. We ask for two groups.
states.why: k-means needs only the points and the number of groups.

states.label: Seed
states.sentence: Pick two starting centroids from the data. Both are poor guesses, close together on the left.
states.why: Any start works; a poor one just takes more rounds.

states.label: Assign 1
states.sentence: Each point joins its nearest centroid. Group A gets one point; Group B takes the rest.
states.why: Nearest means smallest absolute distance to a centroid.

states.label: Update 1
states.sentence: Centroid 2 jumps to the mean of its group, pulled right by the far points.
states.why: The mean is the position that minimizes squared distance for a group.

states.label: Assign 2
states.sentence: Points 2 and 4 are now nearer centroid 1 and switch groups. The far points stay in B.
states.why: Moving a centroid changes which centroid is nearest for some points.

states.label: Update 2
states.sentence: Both centroids move to the means of their new groups, now centered on the two clumps.
states.why: Recomputing means after reassigning can only lower or hold the cost.

states.label: Assign 3
states.sentence: Every point is still nearest to the centroid it already has. No point switches groups.
states.why: With no switches, the next mean update has nothing new to average.

states.label: Converged
states.sentence: The means equal the current centroids, so nothing moves. Assign-then-update has reached a fixed point and stops.
states.why: Same groups give same means; further rounds would repeat forever.
